description: List orders of one event OR of all of an organization's events: buyer name/email, status, costs. Pass exactly one of event_id / organization_id. Eventbrite: GET /events/{event_id}/orders/ or GET /organizations/{organization_id}/orders/.

changed_since.description: Only orders changed on or after this time, in UTC, e.g. 2026-12-01T02:00:00Z.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

event_id.description: Event ID — list this event's orders.

organization_id.description: Organization ID — list orders across all its events.

status.description: active = attending orders, inactive = not attending, both, or all_not_deleted.

name: eventbrite_list_orders
title: List orders
